Their budget-basis schedules print no transfer-out amount (p19 Community Service and p20 Health Department print only 'Transfers in' 1,000,000 / 2,000,000; p22 Veterans prints 'Transfers in transfer out' 500,000 = the transfers in only), and detail[] has no transfer-out line for these funds, so the money is in no detail line; added from the p15 fund columns (out negative). Note: the same budget schedules also leave out the matching p15 Intergovernmental revenue of Community Service 72,530 and Veterans 21,018 (budget basis); not added here (revenue gap already explained by pass 1 as basis).
